name: Davis UWC Scholars Program
host: Davis UWC Scholars Program + US partner colleges
amount: Need-based aid with the partner college (often large; check each partner college)
dlText: No single deadline: apply through each partner college's regular admission and financial-aid deadlines
tags: Admission to a partner US college

eligibility.note: Any nationality, but only graduates of the 18 UWC (United World College) schools who completed the IB Diploma and are admitted to a participating US college

note: Need-based undergraduate aid for UWC graduates at 100+ US partner colleges (106 partners listed for 2026-27). Davis funding is combined with the college's own aid; you must already be a UWC graduate, so this is not open to other students.
